weights_provenance.source: retrained (dfl_capacity.json stores lr/loss/seconds per condition, not weight vectors; dfl_full.json's stored weights are the LINEAR model, wrong shape for rung 2)

verdict_a: Test A: cost_space_rung2's edge over mse_rung2 DOES NOT SURVIVE real MPPI elites (level A: mean +0.1403, p=0.0884, 27/42 non-tied wins, 38/80 seeds tied). Level B (fill-in-the-loop) agrees in direction: mean -0.5391, p=0.00968.
verdict_b: Test B: the fair one-parameter baseline (mse_rung2 + c*dist_unobs, c=-0.20 tuned on train) recovers 58.4% of the mse_rung2->cost_space_rung2 gap; paired sign test cost_space_rung2 vs the tweak: mean +0.1352, p=0.0243. cost_space_rung2 beats the tweak significantly -- per the pre-registered reading, the capacity result STANDS as a genuine learning effect.
